responsibility: Provides the full-width AVX-512 VNNI intrinsic interface for packed integer dot-product accumulate operations used in neural-network kernels. It enables avx512vnni and defines masked and unmasked wrappers for dpbusd, dpbusds, dpwssd, and dpwssds on __m512i vectors, exposing the 512-bit VNNI arithmetic subset distinct from the VL and AVX-VNNI headers.
